SELECT TOP 200
  g.Path AS Host,
  CASE g.HealthState WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Not monitored' END AS Health,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView v WHERE v.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(v.Path, CHARINDEX(';', v.Path + ';') - 1) = g.Path
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = v.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Group')) AS "Cluster groups",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView v WHERE v.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(v.Path, CHARINDEX(';', v.Path + ';') - 1) = g.Path AND v.HealthState IN (2, 3)
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = v.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Group')) AS "Cluster groups not healthy",
  g.StateLastModified AS LastStateChange
FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g
WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND g.Path IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ','))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.NodeRole')
ORDER BY CASE g.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, g.Path

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND g.Path IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ','))
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.NodeRole')) AS "Failover Clustering servers",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND g.Path IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ',')) AND g.HealthState IN (2, 3)
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.NodeRole')) AS "Servers not healthy",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1) IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ','))
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Group')) AS "Cluster groups",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1) IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ',')) AND g.HealthState IN (2, 3)
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Group')) AS "Cluster groups not healthy",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a WHERE a.ResolutionState < 255 AND a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster%'
     AND LEFT(COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName) + ';') - 1) IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ','))) AS "Open Failover Clustering alerts"

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND g.Path IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ','))
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.NodeRole')) AS "Failover Clustering servers",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND g.Path IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ',')) AND g.HealthState IN (2, 3)
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.NodeRole')) AS "Servers not healthy",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1) IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ','))
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Group')) AS "Cluster groups",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1) IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ',')) AND g.HealthState IN (2, 3)
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Group')) AS "Cluster groups not healthy",
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a WHERE a.ResolutionState < 255 AND a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster%'
     AND LEFT(COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName) + ';') - 1) IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ','))) AS "Open Failover Clustering alerts"

SELECT TOP 1000
  REPLACE(REPLACE(g.DisplayName, 'Cluster group ', ''), ' on ' + LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1), '') AS "Cluster group",
  LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1) AS Host,
  CASE g.HealthState WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Not monitored' END AS Health,
  g.StateLastModified AS LastStateChange
FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g
WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND LEFT(g.Path, CHARINDEX(';', g.Path + ';') - 1) IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ','))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Group')
ORDER BY CASE g.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, 3, 1

SELECT DISTINCT TOP 300
  CASE s.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Warning' END AS Health,
  COALESCE((SELECT TOP 1 m.DisplayName FROM dbo.MonitorView m WHERE m.Id = s.MonitorId AND m.DisplayName IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.LanguageCode), s.MonitorName) AS Monitor,
  e.DisplayName AS Object,
  LEFT(COALESCE(e.Path, e.DisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(e.Path, e.DisplayName) + ';') - 1) AS Host,
  s.LastModified AS Since
FROM dbo.StateView s
JOIN dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView e ON e.Id = s.BaseManagedEntityId
WHERE s.HealthState IN (2, 3)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.MonitorView m WHERE m.Id = s.MonitorId AND m.IsUnitMonitor = 1)
  AND e.IsDeleted = 0 AND e.FullName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster%'
  AND LEFT(COALESCE(e.Path, e.DisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(e.Path, e.DisplayName) + ';') - 1) IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ','))
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 5 DESC

SELECT TOP 300
  CASE a.Severity WHEN 2 THEN 'Critical' WHEN 1 THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Information' END AS Severity,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.AlertStringName, ''), a.Name) AS Alert,
  CAST(a.Id AS varchar(36)) AS AlertId,
  a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName AS Source,
  LEFT(COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName) + ';') - 1) AS Host,
  a.RepeatCount AS Repeats,
  a.TimeRaised AS Raised
FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a
WHERE a.ResolutionState < 255 AND a.TimeRaised BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster%'
  AND LEFT(COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName), CHARINDEX(';', COALESCE(a.MonitoringObjectPath, a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName) + ';') - 1) IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ','))
ORDER BY a.Severity DESC, a.TimeRaised DESC

WITH x AS (
  SELECT h.DisplayName AS host,
         CASE WHEN et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Group' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(e.DisplayName, 'Cluster group ', ''), ' on ' + h.DisplayName, '') ELSE '(server)' END AS scope,
         r.ObjectName AS o, r.CounterName AS c, p.SampleValue AS v, p.DateTime AS t,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.ManagedEntityRowId, r.RuleRowId, i.InstanceName ORDER BY p.DateTime DESC) AS rn
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType et ON et.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster%'
    AND p.DateTime > DATEADD(hour, -24, GETUTCDATE())
    AND h.DisplayName IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ','))
)
SELECT TOP 500 host AS Host, scope AS Scope, o AS Object, c AS Counter, v AS Value, t AS "Sampled (UTC)"
FROM x WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY host, scope, o, c

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0) AS time,
         CASE WHEN et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Group' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(e.DisplayName, 'Cluster group ', ''), ' on ' + h.DisplayName, '') + ' (' + h.DisplayName + ')' ELSE h.DisplayName END AS metric,
         AVG(p.SampleValue) AS value
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType et ON et.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster%'
    AND r.ObjectName + '|' + r.CounterName = '${clcounter}'
    AND h.DisplayName IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ','))
  GROUP BY DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0), e.DisplayName, et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName, h.DisplayName, r.CounterName
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.DateTime,
         CASE WHEN et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.Group' THEN REPLACE(REPLACE(e.DisplayName, 'Cluster group ', ''), ' on ' + h.DisplayName, '') + ' (' + h.DisplayName + ')' ELSE h.DisplayName END,
         AVG(p.AverageValue)
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = p.ManagedEntityRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType et ON et.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
  JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) > 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster%'
    AND r.ObjectName + '|' + r.CounterName = '${clcounter}'
    AND h.DisplayName IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('${clhost:csv}', ','))
  GROUP BY p.DateTime, e.DisplayName, et.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName, h.DisplayName, r.CounterName
) x ORDER BY time

list.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT h.DisplayName AS __text, h.DisplayName AS __value
FROM dbo.vManagedEntity e
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntityType t ON t.ManagedEntityTypeRowId = e.ManagedEntityTypeRowId
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity h ON h.ManagedEntityRowId = e.TopLevelHostManagedEntityRowId
WHERE t.ManagedEntityTypeSystemName LIKE 'Microsoft.Windows.Cluster.NodeRole'
ORDER BY 1
